title: IntelliVoice AP Automation — Product Benchmark Sheet

snippet: IntelliVoice delivers 98% straight-through processing and a 0.4% exception error rate across deployments.
content: IntelliVoice AP Automation delivers industry-leading results. Across our deployed customer base we achieve 98 percent straight-through processing on supplier invoices, with an exception error rate of just 0.4 percent. Customers typically reach full straight-through processing within eight weeks of deployment, with no process standardisation work required beforehand. Our machine learning models adapt automatically to supplier variation, eliminating the need for the lengthy process remediation programmes that traditional consultancies recommend. Average payback across our customer base is under six months.
